bodyHtml:
Born and raised in Plymouth, MA, Barbara earned her B.A. in Art at Emmanuel College in Boston, and her M.S. in Art Education and Sixth Year in Administration from Central CT State University. Her professional career was spent in Connecticut, teaching art and supervising the art program in the fifteen public schools of the City of Bristol, for 35 years.

An en plein air landscape and garden painter in pastel, oil, and watercolor, she and her husband George live full time in Harwich. She loves to record and share her impressions of the Cape’s natural beauty.

Barbara is a member of the Pastel Painters Society of Cape Cod, the Guild of Harwich Artists, the Creative Arts Center in Chatham, the Cultural Center of Cape Cod and is a juried artist member of the Cape Cod Art Association. She has exhibited in various locations in Connecticut and Massachusetts, and her artwork hangs in private collections and professional offices.
